Class AlgoExecutionState

java.lang.Object
grafiosch.entities.BaseID<Integer>
grafiosch.entities.TenantBaseID
grafioschtrader.entities.AlgoExecutionState
@Entity public class AlgoExecutionState extends TenantBaseID
Fill-derived position lifecycle. Exported with the tenant; runtime writes are bounded by the execution-state limit.

initialUnits and realizedExitUnits carry the progress of a profit taking plan: the size the lifecycle was opened with, and how much of it has already been given back. Both are projections of the ledger like every other field here, so a tranche can neither execute twice nor be lost across a restart.
